title: MoonVeil
description: MoonVeil, an old school Minecraft RPG Modpack experience!
body:
MoonVeil

Your Journy has only jsut beugn..

Moon veil is a fantasy RPG with an expansive create ecosystem for the more "technology" focused players.
Base combat is moderately changed to add better animations and new damage techniques such as, rolling, evading, crouching ETC.

MoonVeil also offers an expansive boss and quesline system to keep you motivated, 
the project is still very much a work in progress, with the questlines being at the very beginning stages of being written.

for the time being there is a subsitute that uses advancements as a basic questline. it is temporary to ensure a great idea of what the finished product will be!
